variants.name: .45 Super
variants.info:
Modernised version of the .45 ACP cartridge made of stronger brass and filled with more powder. All without changing the original cartridge dimensions.
Increases overall bullet performance, with poorer damage in range. Greater velocity and range.

variants.name: 9x19mm
variants.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MAC-10 into 9x19mm!
Shoots significantly faster. Reduces recoil and improves bullet speed but weaker damage!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Plus P
variants.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
